title: MSRV 1.75 is declared but no member crate inherits rust-version
description:
Cargo.toml:15 sets `rust-version = "1.75"` under `[workspace.package]`. None of the six member crates opt in — grep for `rust-version` across all Cargo.toml files returns exactly one hit, the workspace one. persona-core, persona-attestors, persona-grpc, personad, persona and persona-nmh each inherit `version` and `edition` via `.workspace = true` but not `rust-version`.

`[workspace.package]` is a template, not an inherited default: a key is only applied to a crate that writes `key.workspace = true`. So every crate in this workspace currently declares no MSRV at all.

Three concrete consequences:
1. Clippy has no MSRV to respect, and is actively suggesting an API that would break the declared one — persona-grpc/src/service.rs:125 gets `unnecessary_map_or` pointing at `Option::is_none_or`, stabilised in 1.82. Applying the lint's own suggestion (or `cargo clippy --fix`) silently raises the real MSRV by seven releases.
2. Cargo's MSRV-aware dependency resolution has nothing to work with, so `cargo update` can pull a dependency that requires a newer rustc and the failure only shows up in the separate 1.75 CI job.
3. The published crates advertise no MSRV to downstream users.

The CI job at .github/workflows/ci.yml:44-54 does build on 1.75, so the MSRV is being tested — but note it runs bare `cargo build` with no `--all-targets` and no `--all-features`, so the `fido2` feature path and all test code are unchecked against 1.75.

Fix: add `rust-version.workspace = true` to all six member `[package]` sections. Optionally add `msrv = "1.75"` to a clippy.toml so the lints match.
close_reason: Duplicate of persona-5s4b.19 (same defect, filed by a second review agent from a different angle). Merged during review triage; reopen if the angle in this issue is not covered there.
